{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
raw_data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
raw_data['revenue'] = raw_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for converted customers (converted == 1)
converted_customers = raw_data[raw_data['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out missing age (age == -1)
valid_ages = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_ages['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding missing age): {mean_age}")"}
